observations.finding: Prompt and candidate descriptions use mean token embeddings; their word order is erased. Same-token relational reversals cannot be distinguished by those channels.
observations.implication: Do not claim general question/rubric semantics; replace with order-sensitive contextual representation for that goal.

observations.finding: Local positions exist within each context span, but attention aggregates spans without a global span-order representation. Reordering unchanged sentences does not represent changed chronology.
observations.implication: Full token accounting is not long-context temporal reasoning; future encoder/aggregation needs source/global position and suitable supervision.

observations.finding: Every vocabulary-missing token maps to one learned UNK row. Accepting unseen descriptions demonstrates variable-candidate transport capacity, not understanding of unseen meanings.
observations.implication: Measure semantic transfer on held-out tasks and meanings; retain explicit review/unknown policy.

observations.finding: The eight-second socket watchdog closes a connection; it does not interrupt model CPU work. The server is single-process and single-request, with explicit model work refusals rather than a hard per-request inference deadline.
observations.implication: Development loopback scope only; production needs process isolation/deadline enforcement and load/recovery qualification.

positive_checks: Scoring consumes context, prompt and option descriptions; administrative IDs and numeric anchors are not semantic features.
Shared complete-candidate logits and stable softmax are coherent; analytical attention, positional and embedding gradient paths match their documented equations by source review.
Typed decoding maps IDs/booleans/numeric expectations after scoring and enforces normalized finite distributions, review-only values and uncalibrated probability semantics.
Artifacts bind registry, model metadata, raw float64 weights and complete receipt; loading uses bounded regular bytes and refuses symlink ancestors/nonfinite parameters.
Private config generation uses fresh keys, explicit registry pinning and exclusive creation; API HMAC binds method/path/body and nonce lifetime covers accepted future timestamps.
HTTP host/origin/framing/body/rate and redaction controls are present; browser renders via textContent, retains key material in memory and guards stale session results.
Source and test descriptions avoid claiming pretrained general language competence, independent quality, calibration, action authority or JEV parity.
